name_zh: 藤森/内战/民主修复：后冲突民主修复与新自由主义重构
name_en: Fujimori/Civil War/Democratic Repair: Post-Conflict Democratic Repair & Neoliberal Restructuring
description_zh: 阿尔韦托·藤森 (1938-2024) 秘鲁总统 (1990-2000)，1992 自我政变/新宪法/反光辉道路/新自由主义改革/2000 腐败逃亡/2007 引渡/2009 判刑/2023 赦免/2024 病逝。核心治理张力：威权稳定(反恐/新自治法/军警一体化)vs 民主破坏(自我政变/媒体控制/贪腐/人权侵犯)vs 经济奇迹(通胀 7000%→个位数/私有化/投资/出口)。体现 M193 后冲突民主修复 — 以"威权镇压+新自由主义重构+民主修复+真相和解"四位一体，在光辉道路恐怖主义/恶性通胀/民主崩塌三重危机中实现极限生存与部分修复。
description_en: Alberto Fujimori (1938-2024) Peru President (1990-2000), 1992 self-coup/new constitution/defeat Shining Path/neoliberal reforms/2000 corruption flight/2007 extradition/2009 conviction/2023 pardon/2024 death. Core governance tensions: authoritarian stability (counter-terrorism/new organic law/military-police fusion) vs democratic destruction (self-coup/media control/corruption/human rights abuses) vs economic miracle (inflation 7000%->single digits/privatization/investment/exports). Exemplifies M193 Post-Conflict Democratic Repair — quaternity of 'authoritarian suppression + neoliberal restructuring + democratic repair + truth & reconciliation' achieving extreme survival & partial repair amid triple crisis of Shining Path terrorism/hyperinflation/democratic collapse.
reason_zh: 藤森非单纯独裁者，而是"威权反恐+新自由主义经济奇迹+民主破坏"三位一体极限治理者。以军警铲除光辉道路(7万人死亡)，以休克疗法治愈恶性通胀，以自我政变摧毁民主制度。M193 区隔于 M171 资源民族主义(查韦斯)、M169 后资源转型(沙特)、M193 后民粹修复(委内瑞拉反对派)，核心在于"威权反恐即生存前提+新自由主义即经济重构+民主修复即道德代价"的秘鲁极限治理范式。
reason_en: Fujimori not mere dictator but 'authoritarian counter-terrorism + neoliberal economic miracle + democratic destruction' trinity extreme governor. Military-police crushed Shining Path (70k deaths), shock therapy cured hyperinflation, self-coup destroyed democratic institutions. M193 distinct from M171 Resource Nationalist (Chavez), M169 Post-Resource Transition (Saudi), M193 Post-Populist Repair (Venezuela opposition), core: 'authoritarian counter-terrorism as survival prerequisite + neoliberalism as economic restructuring + democratic repair as moral cost' Peru extreme governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 威权反恐与自我政变：1992 解散国会/宪法法院/司法/媒体控制/军警一体化/1993 新宪法/连任合法化
新自由主义休克疗法：通胀 7649%→个位数/国企私有化/外资开放/贸易自由化/财政平衡/投资信心恢复
反光辉道路/图帕克·阿马鲁：情报/军警/农民自卫队/领袖古铁雷斯/拉莫斯捕获/恐怖主义基本铲除
贪腐体系与逃亡：蒙蒂诺斯情报网/贿赂媒体/司法/军警/国企/2000 录像曝光/藤森逃亡日本/国际通缉/2007 智利引渡
民主修复与真相和解：2001 托莱多上台/真相与和解委员会/藤森/蒙蒂诺斯判刑/受害者赔偿/制度改革/民主巩固
steps_en: Authoritarian counter-terrorism & self-coup: 1992 dissolved Congress/Constitutional Court/judiciary/media control/military-police fusion/1993 new constitution/reelection legalized
Neoliberal shock therapy: inflation 7649%->single digits/SOE privatization/FDI opening/trade liberalization/fiscal balance/investment confidence restored
Shining Path/MRTA defeat: intelligence/military-police/peasant self-defense/leaders Guzman/Ramos captured/terrorism largely eliminated
Corruption system & flight: Montesinos intel network/bribed media/judiciary/military/SOEs/2000 videotape exposed/Fujimori fled Japan/international warrant/2007 Chile extradition
Democratic repair & truth & reconciliation: 2001 Toledo takes office/Truth & Reconciliation Commission/Fujimori/Montesinos convicted/victim reparations/institutional reforms/democratic consolidation
expected_zh: 以"威权反恐+新自由主义重构+民主修复+真相和解"四位一体，在恐怖主义/恶性通胀/民主崩塌三重危机中实现极限生存与部分修复，留下威权代价与民主修复双重遗产。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'authoritarian suppression + neoliberal restructuring + democratic repair + truth & reconciliation' achieves extreme survival & partial repair amid triple crisis of terrorism/hyperinflation/democratic collapse, leaving dual legacy of authoritarian cost & democratic repair.
case_zh: 1990 当选/1992 自我政变/1993 新宪法/1995 连任/2000 蒙蒂诺斯录像/逃亡/2007 引渡/2009 判刑 25 年/2017 人道赦免/2023 赦免/2024 病逝，威权-经济-民主三重遗产纠缠。
case_en: 1990 elected/1992 self-coup/1993 new constitution/1995 reelected/2000 Montesinos tape/flight/2007 extradition/2009 25-year sentence/2017 humanitarian pardon/2023 pardon/2024 death, authoritarian-economic-democratic triple legacy entangled.
intellectual_tradition: Peruvian Authoritarian Neoliberalism / Counter-Terrorism / Democratic Transition
cross_cultural_impact: Authoritarian counter-terrorism model; neoliberal shock therapy; self-coup precedent; truth commission
